description: This file is a shell script for testing the reftable backend in a Git repository. It sets environment variables, sources a test library, and contains test cases that initialize repositories, modify reftable tables, and verify repository integrity, reporting errors or warnings as appropriate.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a provided description and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository.

methods.name: git update-ref
methods.description: Updates a reference to point to a specific commit.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for testing.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines in a file and tests against a condition.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: git refs verify
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of references in the repository.
